fusions.name: Wring Out
fusions.desc: A squeezing grip deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Sure Grip
fusions.desc: Seizes an enemy, which deals 30 damage as a critical hit, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeled Into Reach
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightening Hold
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once and strike it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (170% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
